description: This file implements resource grid management for a scheduler in a wireless communication system, including classes and methods for handling subslot resource grids, collision detection, and resource allocation for carriers and slots.

classes.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid
classes.description: Manages resource grid for a specific carrier subslot, including filling, clearing, and collision detection.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_grid
classes.description: Represents resource grids for all carriers within a cell slot, providing methods for collision detection and resource usage queries.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator
classes.description: Allocates resources within a cell slot, managing slot indication and resource filling/clearing.

classes.name: cell_resource_allocator
classes.description: Manages overall resource allocation for a cell, including multiple slot resource grids and slot indication handling.

methods.name: get_max_scs
methods.description: Returns the maximum subcarrier spacing from a list.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::clear
methods.description: Clears the resource grid for the carrier subslot.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::fill
methods.description: Fills the resource grid with specified OFDM symbols and CRB intervals or lists.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::collides
methods.description: Checks for collision with another resource grid or CRB list within specified symbols.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::used_crbs
methods.description: Returns used CRBs within specified CRB limits and symbols.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::used_prbs
methods.description: Returns used PRBs within specified CRB limits and symbols.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::all_set
methods.description: Checks if all CRBs within specified symbols and CRB interval are set.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::fill
methods.description: Fills resource grid for a given grant or specific carrier/scs with symbols and CRBs.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::clear
methods.description: Clears resource grid for a given grant or specific carrier/scs with symbols and CRBs.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::collides
methods.description: Checks for collision between resource grids for grants, carriers, or CRB intervals.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::used_crbs
methods.description: Returns used CRBs for a given BWP configuration or specific scs and CRB limits.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::used_prbs
methods.description: Returns used PRBs for a given scs, CRB limits, and symbols.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::all_set
methods.description: Checks if all CRBs within a grant or specified symbols and CRB interval are set.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::get_carrier
methods.description: Retrieves the carrier resource grid for a specific scs.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator::slot_indication
methods.description: Indicates a new slot and resets previous resource allocations.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator::clear
methods.description: Clears all resource allocations and results.

methods.name: cell_resource_allocator::slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication, setting up resource grids for the slot.

methods.name: cell_resource_allocator::stop
methods.description: Stops resource allocation, clearing all slot data.
